acceptance: ADR-003 addendum merged answering (1)-(3) with the exact rule and the list of named unsafe combinations.
context:
Source: tuning remediation plan rev2 (2026-10-01; adversarial re-review of develop d39166ea plus independent plan review). Plan gate D-5, restated after plan review F9 (original 'error everywhere' conflicted with ADR-003 warn-first).

Closed by PR #2634 (squash-merged 2026-10-04, merge SHA 16ceaa48fe9c821d48697df4c0846422f57fda1b): ADR-003 addendum "requested-but-not-rendered is a named unsafe combination" in docs/development/tuning-adr-003-baseline-and-single-renderer.md.

DECISION (owner-endorsed 2026-10-04):
(1) YES: a requested tuning type that the capability registry marks rendered_via="none" or ":preview_only" for the target platform is a validation ERROR, named the "requested-but-not-rendered" unsafe combination.
(2) YES: unknown platforms (Trino, Athena) error on unsupported types, same as known platforms.
(3) YES: "ClickHouse PRIMARY KEY is not a prefix of the sorting key" is a named unsafe combination (validation error before schema creation).
Warn-first still applies to everything not named.
Sequencing guard: the severity change for (1)-(2) lands with the capability-single-source-validator work (main workstream) together with the per-platform renderers that flip registry entries, and ships with a test that every shipped template, every tuned-fallback and every auto config validates clean on its own platform. A shipped config that trips the block is a defect to fix there, not a reason to weaken the rule. (3) is independent and lands with the ClickHouse key handling.
description:
## Problem
ADR-003 Decision 1: compatibility checks warn first, and a run is blocked only for explicit, named unsafe combinations (`docs/development/tuning-adr-003-baseline-and-single-renderer.md:99-104`).

Yet the validator (`validate_for_platform_detailed`) accepts tuning that execution never applies. The capability registry itself says "postgresql/redshift/bigquery/mysql render nothing at execution" (`benchbox/core/tuning/capability_registry.py:174`):
- partitioning is accepted on PostgreSQL, BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks and DuckDB;
- distribution and sorting are accepted on Redshift.

Trino and Athena only warn on unsupported types because they are not "known" platforms (`benchbox/core/tuning/interface.py:1595-1604`).

## Must decide
- **(1)** Does a requested type that the registry marks `rendered_via="none"` or `:preview_only` block the run? Recommended: yes.
- **(2)** Do unknown platforms (Trino, Athena) error on unsupported types? Recommended: yes.
- **(3)** List the ClickHouse "PRIMARY KEY not a prefix of the sort key" rule among the named unsafe combinations. It is already ADR-consistent.

## Guardrails
- No validator severity change before this gate is done.

## Gate protocol
- This is a decision record, not an implementation.
- Implementation items that list this gate in `needs` must not start until it is done.
- The decision owner is the maintainer.
- Record the outcome as a dated ADR addendum (addenda only; do not rewrite recorded decisions) and paste the decision into this item's context before finishing.
